item.name: COMBO: Sunset and Manta Ray Snorkel
item.unicode: COMBO: Sunset and Manta Ray Snorkel
item.description:
#Join us for Kona's #1 marine encounter!  

##Duration
2.25 Hours

##About
Start your adventure by watching one of our legendary Kona sunsets as we sail along the Kona coast to our snorkel destination (Manta Ray Village).  Once we arrive at the snorkel location, receive a full safety briefing before joining our guides in the water to snorkel with the majestic hahalua (manta rays).  Afterwards, join us back on the boat for hot cocoa, and hot tea enjoying the lights of Kona town as we make our back to the pier.

Trip includes all snorkel equipment (with instruction), T-top wetsuits and all non-alcoholic beverages, with beer, wine and spirits available for purchase.

Because the manta rays are wild animals, we also offer one of the best manta guarantees in the industry.  If you go out with us and do not see a manta ray, we will rebook you again for free (subject to availability, does not apply to "ride along" guests).

Check in is 45 MINUTES PRIOR TO YOUR SCHEDULED DEPARTURE TIME

##Please note:
All guests getting in the water MUST know how to swim without the assistance of a flotation device.

#Important notes about your trip:

***PLEASE CHECK-IN AT OUR KONASTYLE STORE NO LATER THAN 30 MINUTES PRIOR TO YOUR SCHEDULED DEPARTURE TIME.  Our office is located inside the Courtyard Marriott King Kamehameha Beach Hotel, directly adjacent to the pool***

**75-5660 Palani Road, Suite C8, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740**  

Please do *NOT* check-in at the boat as you will be redirected to check-in at our retail store.  

**All guests getting into the water MUST KNOW HOW TO SWIM WITHOUT THE ASSISTANCE OF A FLOTATION DEVICE.  If it is determined by our Captains and/or crew members that a guest does not have adequate swimming abilities, the guest will be directed back to the boat and their purchase will NOT be refunded**

***REMEMBER TO BRING THE FOLLOWING:***
-  *TOWEL* 
-  *SWIMSUIT*
-  *SUN PROTECTION (such as a hat and sunglasses)*
-  *Underwater camera or gopro*
-  *Anti nausea medication (if you are prone to sea/motion sickness)*
-  *We have ample space on board to store any personal belongings such as a small bag or backpack if you wish to bring one.* 

***USE OF FULL-FACE SNORKEL MASKS***
Please be advised that due to safety reasons, we do NOT allow the use of full-face snorkel masks on any of our tours

***Please Note: Our full bar onboard is cashless. We accept all major credit cards and tap pay for your convenience***

***PARKING***
For guests that will be joining us on a tour and wish to park at the Courtyard Marriott King Kamehameha Hotel, located at **75 5660 Palani Road, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740**, they do receive a discounted rate of $13 per vehicle for the entire day.  If you decide to take advantage of this option, **please remember to bring your parking ticket with you to check-in.  The fee will be processed and we will issue you the special parking sticker for your ticket at check-in.**

***OTHER PARKING OPTIONS IN THE GENERAL AREA -***

*Free Municipal Parking Lot:* 
**75 5668 Kuakini Hwy, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740.**  

Directions to the free municipal parking lot are as follows:
Heading SOUTH on Highway 19 (Queen Ka'ahumanu Highway):
-  Turn right onto Palani Road. 
-  At your second stoplight, turn left on KUAKINI Highway. 
-  Approximately 150 yards on your right hand side is Likana Lane, which is where the free municipal parking lot is located. 
-  From the parking lot, just walk towards the ocean and turn right on Ali'i Drive
-  We are located at the Courtyard Marriott King Kamehameha Beach Hotel and Resort adjacent to the pool and the fitness center.

Heading NORTH on Highway 11 (Mamalahoa Highway):
-  Turn left onto Palani Road
-  At your second stoplight, turn left on KUAKINI Highway 
-  Approximately 150 yards on your right-hand side is Likana Lane, which is where the free municipal parking lot is located. 
-  From the parking lot, just walk towards the ocean and turn right on Ali'i Drive
-  We are located at the Courtyard Marriott King Kamehameha Beach Hotel and Resort adjacent to the pool and the fitness center.


***INTERNATIONAL PHONE NUMBERS***
For international numbers, we can only contact you by email. Please check your email regularly and be sure to contact us at least 24 hours prior to your scheduled departure time for important alerts regarding your trip.


Mahalo for choosing KONASTYLE and we look forward to having you aboard!

item.cancellation_notes:
#Cancellations / Rebookings
Customers will receive a full refund provided cancellations are made **at least 48 hours prior to scheduled departure time (7 days for private charters).***Cancellations within 48 hours of scheduled departure time, no shows or guests that check-in late and miss the tour will NOT be refunded.***  Additionally, guests that reschedule their tour within 48 hours of scheduled departure time (7 days for private charters) will be subject to a rebooking fee.  Customers will receive a full refund in case of *Operator cancellations* due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.

#Manta Ray Guarantee
***Please be advised that manta rays are wild animals and WE DO NOT OFFER REFUNDS to guests that join us on a manta ray snorkel and do not see manta rays.*** In the event you go out with us on a manta ray snorkel and do not see manta rays, we will attempt to rebook you on another night for free (subject to availability).  We always recommend that guests book this experience as early in their stay as possible, so that in the unlikely event you do not see a manta ray, we do have the ability to try and rebook you on another evening.  The manta guarantee for rebooking does *not* apply to "ride-along" guests that stay on the boat.

facts.hygiene_policy:
- We do not recommend pregnant women in their third trimester to participate in our trips. All pregnant guests should consult with their healthcare provider prior to booking.

- Full-face snorkel masks are not permitted on any of our excursions.

- Our vessel is not wheelchair accessible. Guests must be able to board and move around the vessel independently. This includes navigating:

- Five-rung ladders to access restrooms,

- A two-foot step over the transom, and

- Five steps to get onto the loading/unloading ramp.
